note: THE PROBE REGISTRY - the single list of every proof and tool in this repo. Read it before running anything: it says what each file asserts, whether the battery runs it, whether a law row may cite it, and whether an agent may run it. Consumers: tools/lib/manifest.mjs (loader + completeness check), scripts/run-battery.mjs (the battery steps), tools/lint-docs.mjs (the law table citable set). Adding a proof = adding one line here. Flags: battery = the proof battery runs it; citable = a law row may cite file::anchor against it; runnable = an agent may RUN it safely (false when it writes); ownerOnly = the owner's alone, agents NEVER run it (measure.mjs is permanently banned - HANDOFF section 1).

probes.name: inscribe
probes.about: The permanent inscription gate. It can REGENERATE the inscribed rows - a proof in its gate mode, an editor otherwise.

probes.name: lengrow-build-proof
probes.about: The length-growth ladder is built at boot from the shipped art and the round transition resets it.

probes.name: pair-proof
probes.about: The slot/idx split: identities and sides never mix (X1, B3, B4, G1, G2, T2).

probes.name: flipproof
probes.about: The drawn flip is the drawn flip - the art transition, not the spin recoil.

probes.name: leadproof
probes.about: The edge-leading mirror: covering circles versus drawn art, the entry-pose gap, the swat touch class.

probes.name: seam-proof
probes.about: The growth seams and boot guards: every damaging hit grows, traits reset per round, a new trait axis needs an authored brief.

probes.name: law-proof
probes.about: B1 best of 3 / first to 2 round wins, B2 a round ends only on a K.O., U1 the uniform base (omega 3.5, damage 1, hp 100).

probes.name: contact-proof
probes.about: C4 one damage per touch and the re-arm gates, C5 a parry recoils BOTH weapons' spins.

probes.name: shot-proof
probes.about: S1 damage only on shot-touches-body, S5 the substep budget is honoured every tick, S6 every shot is born at its hold-derived launch point.

probes.name: frame-proof
probes.about: The RENDERED-FRAME proof: C3 the weapons are solids to each other (the disclosed band envelope + the visible-tick rate at the tick-entry pose) and the law-3s shot overlaps (reported and ratcheted - the law does not hold on this build).

probes.name: stride-proof
probes.about: measure.mjs reads the sim's chain-pose tape at the sim's own width (FL_SLOTS 18, STRF 37): its own flAt resolves every substep row on a real tape, with a pre-links-r87 control that must fail.

probes.name: lenstep-proof
probes.about: The audit rebuilds a GROWN chain at its true length: every chain-aware recompute site in measure.mjs and frame-proof carries lenStep, and on real fights a hit or parry recomputed with the pre-tick lenStep is an exact touch (link-add ticks are reported, not asserted), with a without-lenStep vacuity check and a mutated-source control that must fail.

probes.name: chromecheck
probes.about: The renderer harness: boots both script blocks against DOM stubs and checks the drawn chrome (the PAIRING section backs X1).

probes.name: lengrow-gate
probes.about: The inscribed-covering gate. EXITS 1 BY DESIGN: a uniform stretch breaks the inscribed gate at k=1.0778 (+7.8%), proving the pre-baked ladder is required.

probes.name: lengrow-bake-verify
probes.about: Verifies the baked LEN_CIRCLES ladder against the shipped art. Without --verify this file REGENERATES the canonical - never run it bare.

probes.name: fingerprint
probes.about: The change detector: hashes the full per-tick sim state over 8 cells and judges it against .qa/BASELINE. Proves 'did not move', never 'is right'.

probes.name: strip-hash
probes.about: The comment-only proof: no code token moved, so no law moved. The three invariant hashes.

probes.name: lengrow-proof
probes.about: The length-growth ladder's own read-only proof.

probes.name: flip-seeds
probes.about: Seed generator for the flip family - a diagnostic, not an assertion.

probes.name: bake-rows
probes.about: The re-derived row-splice baker used by lengrow-bake - a writer, never a proof.

probes.name: measure
probes.about: THE OWNER'S AUDIT - renders frames and audits the rendering laws. AGENTS NEVER RUN IT (permanently banned, HANDOFF section 1). The law table's owner-run column cites it.

probes.name: ingest
probes.about: The roster/tooling ingester - it writes back. The owner's alone.
